method: The opt-in source probe reads the bounded raw action-body span with the ACadRust candidate order, then repeats the same sequence with only the two align/miter option encodings changed from BS to RC as listed in LibreDWG dwg2.spec. Every cursor read and payload skip is checked against the 2,343-bit body bound. No production decoder behavior changes.

competingRC.reason: The RC interpretation shifts the subsequent candidate bits and cannot decode the expected bounded 3BD field at this cursor.

interpretation: The ACadRust BS widths are better supported for this exact sample than the LibreDWG RC widths: they produce option values 2/2, valid following fields, the same-handle paired payload sizes, finite transforms and the bounded body endpoint. The test is not independent producer evidence; it does not resolve vector semantics, the one-bit suffix, embedded type-77 geometry, normative field meanings, other profiles/versions, output support or FreeCAD behavior.

validation.physicalProbe: PASS: SWEEP_OPTION_WIDTH BS bits=2342/2343 align=2 miter=2; SWEEP_OPTION_WIDTH RC bits=63/2343 stop=vector
validation.fixturePolicy: No fixture added; existing local sample used in place.

nextAction: Obtain a native or independently authored DWG witness for the action-body order/widths. If ODA remains unavailable in the current desktop session, continue independently ready P4/P6 work and retain raw/Partial/fail-closed behavior.
